title: Spicy Thai Stir Fry
description: Enjoy a quick and flavorful Thai stir fry with noodles, pork, and a touch of zesty goodness.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Add pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add broccoli, garlic, and ginger; cook until the broccoli is tender.
Add noodles and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and chili flakes. Pour the sauce over the noodles and stir-fry until the noodles are well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
If using Chinese broccoli, remove the leaves and slice into smaller pieces before cooking.
Ginger can be grated or sliced thinly before cooking.
Use a thermometer to ensure the oil reaches a safe temperature for cooking.
If you prefer a thicker sauce, mix 1 tablespoon of cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of water and stir it into the sauce before serving.
